text:
nina: kicking off canary for recommendation-service v5.1.0 in safety window 11:00-12:30 UTC. enabling feature flag `rec_v5` at 3% for pilot cohort. release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/recommendation-v5 :mag_right:

deploy-bot: /deploy canary recommendation-service v5.1.0 started by @nina. 4 canary nodes up in us-east1. flag set: `rec_v5_weight=3`
miles: ack. baseline checks passed. circuit-breaker: pause if p95 > 220ms OR 5xx > 0.5% OR recommendation mismatch rate > 0.6%.
zoe: request—split the 3% to logged-in users only (cohort=auth). avoids noise from anonymous traffic.
anita: noted, updating targeting to `cohort=auth` and muting noisy debug logs: `rec_debug=false` for pilot.

sre-bot: monitors attached (p50/p95/p99, error-delta vs baseline, cache hitrate). auto-pinning rules uploaded.

nina: ramp plan idea: weight siphon -> 3% (10m) -> 15% (20m) -> 45% (30m hold) -> 100% staged over 1h. add a version-pin matrix so regions can be pinned independently.
miles: +1. add an early hold at 15% for 10m and require manual ack at 45%. also add conditional: if any region 5xx > 0.9% then region-only pin.

anita: pin script prepared for region pin and global rollback. saving snippets here:
```
# regional pin
/deploy pin recommendation-service v5.0.7 --region me-south --reason "auto-pin-on-5xx"

# full rollback
/deploy rollback recommendation-service --to v5.0.7 --scope global --reason "regression"
```

(9m later)
deploy-bot: canary stable at 3%. metrics: rps 300, p95 110ms, 5xx 0.07%, cache hit 92%. promoting to 15% now. updating: `rec_v5_weight: 3 -> 15`

zoe: good. enabling tracing for regions with <90% cache hit.
sre-bot: me-south p95 increased to 210ms (baseline 160ms) after promotion. 5xx still <0.3%. flagging but not triggering pin.

nina: keep an eye. if me-south 5xx > 0.8% auto-pin that region.
miles: roll forward but add a soft-fallback to v5.0.7 for non-auth users in impacted regions.

(18m later)
sre-bot: ALERT: me-south 5xx rose to 0.95% over 3m. auto-pin condition met. executing region pin.
deploy-bot: executing `/deploy pin recommendation-service v5.0.7 --region me-south --reason "auto-pin-5xx"` -> SUCCESS. me-south traffic reverted to v5.0.7. global canary remains 15% excluding me-south.
anita: capturing traces to /runs/7924681230/traces and adding immediate mitigation: revert local cache TTL bump.

zoe: posting a brief note to #customer-success about regional pin and continuity for impacted users. include opt-out steps for partners.
miles: pausing global ramp until me-south postmortem. checklist before resume: 1) error delta <0.2% for 20m; 2) p95 stable; 3) CPU <75% on canary pool.

(25m later)
sre-bot: me-south traces indicate a cache stampede on cold misses. runbook updated, severity sev3.
anita: created EPIC for cache hardening and a hotfix PR. will ETA a patch tomorrow.
nina: decision: keep me-south pinned; continue ramp to 45% for other regions after the 10m hold. if any other region shows correlated errors we'll trigger full rollback.

miles: final rollback command (copy/paste ready):
```
/deploy rollback recommendation-service --to v5.0.7 --scope global --reason "full-rollback-on-correlated-errors"
```

ops-bot: auto-notice queued to partners for me-south pin. will follow up when unpin occurs.

zoe: thanks team  will reopen thread for postmortem notes and to schedule unpin when patch is validated. :white_check_mark:
